_comment: Madeleine's tool catalog (MADELEINE.md §5) — the shipped copy of
tools/madeleine-eval/catalog.json, with the eval's canned `stub` results
stripped. Everything that decides behaviour is identical, and
AssistantCatalogParityTests fails the build if it stops being: the schemas
the model sees in production must be the schemas that were measured.
`class` is the security model, not documentation. AssistantToolRegistry reads
it and the executor obeys it — a WRITE_GATED tool has no execution path at
all, so model output cannot reach a gated side effect however the model is
A tool is offered to the model only when this milestone can honour it: READ
tools have executors, WRITE_GATED tools need none (the wall answers them).
WRITE_SAFE (M4) and CLIENT (M5) are declared here with their class and are
withheld from the schema list until their milestone lands — offering a tool
that errors is worse than not offering it, and the system prompt already
tells the model to say so plainly when the catalog has no tool for something.

function.name: search_all
function.description: Federated search across every vertical: listings, restaurants, services, posts, people. The primary entry point when the user's intent is not yet narrowed to one vertical.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind. Defaults to ANY.

function.name: get_profile
function.description: The signed-in user's profile: handle, display name, default delivery address, home city.

function.name: search_restaurants
function.description: Restaurants that deliver to the user, optionally filtered by cuisine or name.

maxDeliveryMinutes.description: Only restaurants delivering within this many minutes.

function.name: get_menu
function.description: The menu for one restaurant. Item prices are integer minor units.

function.name: build_cart
function.description: Create or replace the user's delivery cart for one restaurant. Reversible and visible in the app immediately; this does not place an order and does not charge anything.

items.description: Line items to put in the cart.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Place the delivery order for the current cart. Charges the user's wallet at placement. This is a gated action: it requires the user's explicit in-app approval and cannot be executed directly.

function.name: quote_ride
function.description: A suggested fare from the pricing engine for a trip. Read-only: quoting never opens a negotiation and never holds a driver.

function.name: request_ride
function.description: Open a ride negotiation at an offered fare. Gated: money decision, requires explicit user approval.

offerMinor.description: Offered fare in integer minor units.

function.name: get_ride_status
function.description: Status of the user's current or most recent ride.

function.name: get_wallet
function.description: The user's Gojo Wallet balance. There are no wallet write tools; top-ups happen only through Stripe-hosted checkout, which is a human-only surface.

function.name: search_listings
function.description: Search the marketplace for items for sale.

function.name: get_listing
function.description: Full detail for one marketplace listing.

function.name: create_listing_draft
function.description: Create a marketplace listing in DRAFT state. Not visible to anyone else until published.

function.name: publish_listing
function.description: Publish a draft listing so it is publicly visible. Gated: this leaves the user's private space and requires explicit approval.

function.name: create_post_draft
function.description: Draft a social post. Private until published.

function.name: publish_post
function.description: Publish a draft post publicly. Gated: leaves the user's private space.

function.name: draft_message
function.description: Prefill a direct-message composer with suggested text. This only stages a draft; it never sends. There is no tool to read or send direct messages — the user sends by tapping send themselves.

function.name: get_my_bookings
function.description: The user's upcoming service bookings.

function.name: book_service
function.description: Book a service appointment. Gated: money decision, requires explicit approval. Service ids come from search_all with kind=SERVICE.

function.name: navigate_to
function.description: Open a screen in the app for the user. Use this to hand off anything Madeleine cannot operate herself — KYC, wallet top-up, payouts, account settings.
